## HAPI v0.27.2.4

### Compared with the previous maintained release

Rebuilt from current `upstream/main` (`11964b4b0`) with the maintained distribution overlay and carries. Inherits ten upstream commits since v0.27.2.3, including five carried PRs that merged upstream and are now dropped from the carry queue: fleet runner version governance (#1108), searchable session picker (#986), native/deep-link ingest for /share (#1413), voice dictation credential presets (#1474), and Pi queue mid-turn steer (#1480) — plus new upstream fixes #1510 (a2a work_ad ingest stamp), #1504 (session list status hints), #1505 (duplicate queued composer gap), #1513 (share watermark), #1507 (path-only husk mentions).

**PR #1468 (usage cost / per-agent reporting availability) is dropped this cycle** — a bug was found in the usage-display flow, so it is not carried in v0.27.2.4 (schema alignment keeps the deployed V28 ladder intact; the cost columns remain inert on upgraded DBs and are simply not created on fresh ones).

New carries: #1521 (runner integration leak fix), #1518 (cursor ACP list-models race + exit 143), #1519 (fail-closed scheme-less markdown links), #1503 (session-list spinner flicker). Retains all other carries (#1091, #987, #847, #1424, #1422, #1414, #1158, #955, #906, #1436, #1421, #1419, desktop #769, #1469, #1475, #1451, #1418, #1477, #1447, #1429, #1360, #1501, #1498, #1497, #1496, #1495, #1490, #1471, #1484) plus the fork session-roots guard, the schema V24→V28 fork ladder (run_id fence, session_jobs for upstream-shaped DBs, A2A events repair), and the merged fork-main PRs (hub storage breakdown + VACUUM, GitHub-native Gemini review bot).

### Compared with the official release

Same maintained overlay as `v0.27.2.3` minus dropped #1468, plus the new carries above, rebuilt on `upstream/main` `11964b4b0`. Desktop launcher packaging (#769) remains included with the four-part-version and bun-layout packaging fixes.
